lines.text: June light poured into the exam room as the final bell rang.
lines.text_zh: 最后一声铃响时，六月的光涌进考场。

lines.text: I left the last math question half done.
lines.text_zh: 我最后一道数学题只做了一半。

lines.text: You? The champion of every problem?
lines.text_zh: 你？每道题的冠军？

lines.text: I thought about Antarctic data and lost five minutes.
lines.text_zh: 我想到南极数据，走神了五分钟。

lines.text: Outside, teams ran across the field like a race after a long winter.
lines.text_zh: 外面，学生们成队跑过操场，像熬过漫长冬天后的一场比赛。

lines.text: The hot pot steamed between them, red soup and white soup sharing one table.
lines.text_zh: 火锅热气在两人中间升起，红汤白汤共用一张桌。

lines.text: Beef, potato, mushroom, spinach. We are ordering everything.
lines.text_zh: 牛肉、土豆、蘑菇、菠菜。我们全都点。

lines.text: After exams, even vegetables taste like freedom.
lines.text_zh: 考完试以后，连蔬菜都像自由的味道。

lines.text: Check your phone. The mail is from UNEP.
lines.text_zh: 看你的手机。邮件来自联合国环境规划署。

lines.text: They invited both of us to Geneva.
lines.text_zh: 他们邀请我们两个人去日内瓦。

lines.text: Then our next match is bigger than school.
lines.text_zh: 那我们下一场比赛就不只是学校了。

lines.text: A month later, Jiang Che returned to Great Wall Station as a project member.
lines.text_zh: 一个月后，江彻作为项目成员回到长城站。

lines.text: Welcome back. This time, you are not a guest.
lines.text_zh: 欢迎回来。这一次，你不是客人。

lines.text: Then teach me the work, not just the story.
lines.text_zh: 那就教我工作，不只是讲故事。

lines.text: He checked weather equipment, ice cores, and penguin data before sunset.
lines.text_zh: 日落前，他检查气象设备、冰芯和企鹅数据。

lines.text: The signal is still sending. It feels alive.
lines.text_zh: 信号还在发送。它像是活着。

lines.text: Your mother and I saw an aurora here years ago.
lines.text_zh: 很多年前，你妈妈和我在这里看见极光。

lines.text: We wanted more people to know this beauty existed.
lines.text_zh: 我们想让更多人知道，这样的美真实存在。

lines.text: So the signal was a promise.
lines.text_zh: 所以那个信号是一份承诺。

lines.text: Yes. A promise that the next generation might answer.
lines.text_zh: 是的。一份等待下一代回应的承诺。

lines.text: Near the transmitter, Jiang Che found a small green patch on black rock.
lines.text_zh: 在发射器附近，江彻在黑色岩石上发现了一小片绿色。

lines.text: A plant? Here, in this cold?
lines.text_zh: 植物？在这里，在这样的寒冷里？

lines.text: It was lichen, growing slowly like a tiny map of life.
lines.text_zh: 那是地衣，慢慢生长，像一张微小的生命地图。

lines.text: Life does not shout. It grows.
lines.text_zh: 生命不会呐喊。它会生长。

lines.text: An Qi, this lichen may be a hundred years old.
lines.text_zh: 安琪，这片地衣可能已经一百岁了。

lines.text: Wait for me. We will go to Geneva together.
lines.text_zh: 等我。我们一起去日内瓦。

lines.text: In September, flags moved in the wind outside the United Nations building.
lines.text_zh: 九月，联合国大楼外，国旗在风中飘动。

lines.text: Nervous?
lines.text_zh: 紧张吗？

lines.text: No. It feels like a dream I should not wake from.
lines.text_zh: 不。它像一场我不该醒来的梦。

lines.text: Please welcome Jiang Che and An Qi from China.
lines.text_zh: 请欢迎来自中国的江彻和安琪。

lines.text: This lichen grows only a little each year.
lines.text_zh: 这种地衣每年只生长一点点。

lines.text: It survived storms, polar nights, and impossible cold.
lines.text_zh: 它挺过了暴风雪、极夜和难以想象的寒冷。

lines.text: We were high school students when we heard a signal from Antarctica.
lines.text_zh: 当我们听到来自南极的信号时，我们只是高中生。

lines.text: We decoded it, understood it, and chose to answer.
lines.text_zh: 我们破译它，理解它，并选择回应它。

lines.text: Change begins when ordinary people refuse to give up.
lines.text_zh: 当普通人拒绝放弃时，改变就开始了。

lines.text: Protect Antarctica for all humanity.
lines.text_zh: 为全人类保护南极。

lines.text: Applause rose in the hall, but Jiang Che felt strangely calm.
lines.text_zh: 掌声在大厅里响起，但江彻却异常平静。

lines.text: This is not the end.
lines.text_zh: 这不是结束。

lines.text: No. It is the first signal we send back.
lines.text_zh: 不是。这是我们发回去的第一个信号。

lines.text: Far away, lichen grew on rock, and Antarctic Star One walked toward the sea.
lines.text_zh: 远方，地衣在岩石上生长，南极星一号走向大海。
